h1: A product Q&A assistant that answers from your catalog
overview: Shoppers have questions about sizes, materials, shipping and returns, and many leave without asking. We set up a chat assistant that answers from your own product pages, FAQs and policies. It is told to say when it does not know, and to offer a way to reach a person. We load your content, write the rules, test around 50 real questions and review the answers with you before it goes live.

faq: How do you stop wrong answers?
The assistant answers only from the content we load and the rules we write. If a question falls outside it, it says so and offers a way to contact you. We test with real questions before launch.
What about returns and warranty questions?
These are sensitive. We use your exact policy text, and the assistant does not make exceptions or promises. For unusual cases it points shoppers to a person on your team.
As a chat bubble on your store, or on selected pages such as product pages. We choose the position with you and test it so it does not cover your buttons or checkout.
Chat tools store conversations, and the details depend on the tool you pick. We explain this before setup and add a short notice if you want one. You should also mention it in your privacy page.
